about: Decision 134-5: the start storm-server sends a Runtime Host for an approved child. The server's test (apps/server/src/api.rs, the_full_flow_starts_an_approved_child_in_its_own_workspace) makes one through the real routes and compares it with `start`, after putting its own ids, workspace, grants and size in for the placeholders; the host's test (apps/runtime/src/host.rs, an_approved_childs_start_runs_it_in_its_own_clone) dispatches `start` itself to an isolated host. Neither crate depends on the other: this file is what keeps the two halves of the flow on one wire shape.
